notes.title: Prequel Enhanced Edition patch 2.5
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We are finally back with a new version of our Prequel! We will never stop making it better and better... and we really pay attention to your feedback.

General:
- Improved Engine performance
- Improved Visuals
- Improved lots of in-game scenes

New:
- New Character: Fabrizio (Elisa's most trusted waiter).
- New Character: Knight's servant
- Character's thoughts are now displayed in italic

Fixes:
- Karma score now does update correctly
- Trait badge names are now correctly shown
- Fixed occasionally freezes inside the right branch
- Fixed character's transitions
- Fixed the overlapping music
- The exit game now correctly sends the player back to the title screen
- The credits section is now displayed as intended
- Corrected lots of typos
- Lots of improvements to the French, German and Russian version of the game.

Our final game will be available the 16th of February!!!
We are just doing some final tests, making sure it will be as polished as possible at release! We will keep you updated.

http://elisatheinnkeeper.rel.to/store/slide.png

Your support is really awesome!

notes.title: Prequel Enhanced Edition is Here!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

We have finally completed our upgraded Prequel and we are incredibly happy to share it with you.

Basically everything has been redone starting from a brand new set of artworks made by our artist Bicio.

http://elisatheinnkeeper.rel.to/store/asd.png

Our game also introduces some important technical and visual upgrades:

- A brand new Game Engine!
- A new in-game Design
- New GUI
- New character models and expressions
- Refined backgrounds and special scenes
- Now you can personalize everything inside our textbox: choosing font colors, background color, transparency, font style and font attributes!
- Personalizable key bindings.
- New Achievements!
- Move forward or backward just scrolling with your mouse wheel! 
Did you miss something? You can now go back whenever you want.


As well as new features:
- Added the possibility to unlock songs and artworks in a more dynamic way, showing notifications and alerting the player when something new has beed added to the collection.
- A new chapter selection page. 
Jump from a chapter to another without replaying the whole game every time!
- You can now decide to listen to your favourite songs whenever you want! While playing the game just tap into the Music Section and with a click of a button you will be able to overwrite whichever song the game is offering.
- Unlock items, character traits, secret codexes and explore more about the lore behind our story!


A new karma system!
http://elisatheinnkeeper.rel.to/store/karma0.png

We spent a lot of time and effort expanding our story and introducing a huge amount of additional secondary choices that will allow you to play our game very differently.

http://elisatheinnkeeper.rel.to/store/karma1.png

But there is more! Other than making just good or bad choices we introduced  character traits!

http://elisatheinnkeeper.rel.to/store/karma2.png

Our Prequel is also available in the following languages!
 English
 Italian
 French
 German
 Russian


http://elisatheinnkeeper.rel.to/store/languages.png

And a lot more guys.
This is just the beginning. When our final game will be available in Dec 2016/Jan 2017, you will see even more features and stuff.

We are really doing our best in order to create something which will live up to your expectations!

Drop us a like if you can on greenlight! 
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=809707327

Have a nice day!

notes.title: New Patch!
notes.content:
Hi guys!
We have been reading your reviews, some of them were really helpful. Thank you so much!


Story and Corrections
We spent the last few days working on our story improving all branches and adding more details + all the typos should be finally gone!

New languages!
Yeah it is officia! 
French and Brazilian Portuguese subtitles will be added to the game very soon. Most probably in August as a new update

Steam Overlay
A lot of people have requested this feature and it is finally available.
For some reason it works only after you start the actual game (after pressing "Start" or "Continue") but we are looking into it.

http://elisatheinnkeeper.rel.to/gallery/scene_earrings.png

Do you recognize this scene? it is my favorite one!

Please as always let us know about problems or suggestions, your contribution is very important

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Our Prequel will stay FREE Forever + New Stuff!!!
notes.content:
Hi guys

We have really good news!

Well we did put a lot of thoughts into it and we finally decided to leave our Prequel on Steam as a Free to play.

So yeah, there are no doubts about it. We assure you that you will be able to download our Prequel cost free forever. Of course it will be constantly updated, we really like new features!

http://pikapuz.rel.to/elisaimg/scenekiss.jpg

We are also working on a really big thing. Our original plan was to keep it secret... but yeah i really want you guys to know what's happening

Voice recognition!

i'm super bumped right now.... you can give a voice command to the game like "auto play!" and the game starts going on its own!

We really want to give you the possibility to play our novel without the need of mouse and keyboard. I think the best part comes when you need to make an important decision....

We will give you more details in the near future, possibly with the next update.

What do you think? Give us some feedback!

Please consider supporting us on Kickstarter, we just got 3 Days Remaining!!!!! 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2044603064/elisa-the-innkeeper

notes.title: Achievements, New Features, New Art!
notes.content:
Hi guys
We have been working really hard during the last few weeks, developing a game and running a Kikcstarter campaign at the same time is more difficult than we expected.

But yeah... we want to keep promises so here we go:
- Achievements are finally available
- Auto mode has been implemented
- Back-logs too!
- The super annoying black text bug is finally gone
- A lot of improvements to the english version and bug fixes

Obviously we are not done, we will keep updating our Prequel adding the Ecchi Patch when it will be available and even new chapters of our story.

Yeah if you thinkl that the Prequel is short you just need do be patient!


Ah since we reached our first stretch goal on Kickstarter, here is a first preview of our new art!
http://elisatheinnkeeper.rel.to/gallery/balcony.jpg


Keep supporting us guys, we really want to create a great game!
Have a good day!

notes.title: Major update and Ecchi Patch Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hi guys
We have spent the last few days reading your reviews and suggestions.
First of all thank you very much for your support!

We have updated our game several times since our Prequel has been released, correcting typos and other really nasty bugs concerning our gallery, artworks, text color and textbox transparency and our game in general.

Obviously we are working on something really big! Our first Major Update will feature:
- Achievements
- A new in game section where you will be able to unlock and listen to our songs
- Auto-advance function
- Display text function
- More textbox colors, text colors and fonts

We noticed that a huge number of people is actually eager to play a game with a bigger amount of fan-service in it. Or maybe they are only after some more romance options?

Well we are actually considering this option!
You will be able to enable or disable the content freely in our game's config page.


Thanks for your support and please consider helping us on kickstarter! The future of our game is in your hands!
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2044603064/elisa-the-innkeeper
